forbiddenOutcome.description: A stale model output, unsupported intent claim, or executable pre-boundary branch survives the memory release boundary as raw context.

invariant: Stale and unsupported working-memory payloads must be conserved, compressed, quarantined, or killed after a receipt-bound boundary.
title: stale output survived boundary
whyFlowPulseMatters: The receipt-bound FlowPulse is the trigger that turns stale working memory into release products instead of raw post-boundary context.
